title: Reconcile GitHub issue-comment response schema and governed Admin dispatch parity

phases.objective: Align the existing active/ready github_create_issue_comment SQL endpoint with the canonical GitHub 201 response contract and expose that same reviewed endpoint through the existing admin-only github_rest_endpoint_dispatch surface without weakening mutation governance, silently choosing ambiguous registry rows, or creating a second execution path.

e2e_journeys.actor: Platform admin discovering, preflighting, approving, executing, and reading back the canonical GitHub issue-comment mutation through the governed registry dispatcher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exactly one existing active/ready POST issue-comment endpoint retains a 201 JSON object response schema, appears in exactly one intended admin-only export and dispatch binding, and cannot reach provider dispatch until explicit approval, completed preflight evidence, live execution approval, and required same-cycle readback are present.
steps: Count the exact canonical endpoint and exact enabled Admin dispatcher candidates before any registry mutation; proceed only when both cardinalities are exactly one.

Use the existing github_create_issue_comment endpoint row with a non-null canonical endpoint_id; do not register a replacement endpoint or accept caller-supplied method, URL, or authorization material.
Reconcile responses.201 on that exact active/ready POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/comments row with the response class already defined by the canonical compiled GitHub schema.

Add github_create_issue_comment to the existing canonical github_rest_endpoint_dispatch endpoint-key allowlist only when absent without tightening the shared pull-request body field used by other GitHub operations.

Create or repair one admin platform endpoint export whose logical identity and source_endpoint_id point to the exact canonical endpoint and whose input_schema_json is copied from endpoints.schema_json.

Create or repair one active db_admin_tool dispatch binding for github_issue_comments_write / github_issue_comment_create using the same export and endpoint source identity through runtime_endpoint_call.
Use runtime_endpoint_preview for no-provider-call preflight; a dry_run or preflight_only request submitted directly to the create-comment facade fails closed before provider dispatch.

Before live issue-comment dispatch, require explicit mutation approval, completed preflight evidence, live_execution_approved, and a required non-none same-cycle readback contract at platform endpoint binding selection.
Use v_platform_endpoint_export_schema_parity for general export parity and v_github_issue_comment_dispatch_parity for exact endpoint/201/allowlist/export/binding post-apply readiness.
assertions: The canonical compiled GitHub schema already declares createIssueComment with a 201 Created application/json Comment response.

The migration updates only the existing github_create_issue_comment endpoint selected by exact parent action, endpoint key, non-null endpoint_id, POST method, issue-comments path, active status, ready execution state, and http_generic_api transport.

Endpoint or canonical Admin dispatcher candidate cardinality other than exactly one prevents endpoint and dispatcher mutation as well as export/binding creation; there is no first-row selection or partial endpoint-only apply.
The canonical Admin dispatcher identity includes POST /system/tools/call with fixed_body.name=runtime_endpoint_call rather than relying on tool_key alone.
The migration does not INSERT a new endpoints row and therefore cannot create a competing provider-operation identity.
The SQL endpoint receives a responses.201 application/json object schema that tolerates additive GitHub comment fields.
The Admin dispatcher allowlist gains github_create_issue_comment idempotently without adding minLength to the shared body.body property, so unrelated operations can still clear a pull-request body.
The export upsert repairs export_key, parent_action_key, endpoint_key, tenant_id, source_endpoint_id, and schema parity to the canonical admin identity.
The binding upsert repairs binding_id, parent_action_key, endpoint_key, tool_key, export/source identity, and remains registry-driven through runtime_endpoint_call.

The platform endpoint facade blocks github_create_issue_comment before provider dispatch unless approval, completed preflight evidence, live execution approval, and required same-cycle readback are all present; read-only GitHub bindings remain unaffected.
Direct dry-run/preflight requests for github_create_issue_comment fail closed with runtime_endpoint_preview guidance and provider_call_allowed=false.

v_github_issue_comment_dispatch_parity returns ready only when exact ready/http_generic_api endpoint identity, 201 response schema, canonical Admin dispatcher allowlist, source-bound export schema parity, and a binding joined to that same export and endpoint all converge to one; otherwise it returns blocked.

No provider call, credential payload read, raw secret access, external send, external write, DB migration apply, Production mutation, generated-artifact edit, force push, PREPARE, or EXECUTE is performed by the source change.
This bounded change closes only github_create_issue_comment registry/export parity; it does not claim full platform catalog/runtime/certification parity or close #4451.
